rss: Graduate job vacancies drop by almost 50% in a year, survey suggests
title: Jobs for Grads Hard to Find
story: There are fewer jobs for young people who just finished school. It's the lowest since a long time ago!
storyBig: The number of job opportunities for recent graduates has plummeted to its lowest level in years, indicating a challenging job market for newcomers. This decline could impact the economic prospects of these individuals significantly.
think: What skills might help kids get jobs in the future?
bull: Kids can learn new skills to prepare for jobs.
bear: Finding a job could be tough when they grow up.

rss: How to get £2,000 to play computer games at university
title: Get Paid to Play Video Games!
story: A school is paying kids to play video games while they study. It's a way to mix fun and learning!
storyBig: A university is offering scholarships for students to engage in esports while pursuing their studies, blending gaming with educational goals. This initiative aims to attract students who are passionate about gaming, potentially boosting enrollment and interest in esports careers.
think: How can playing games be part of learning?
bull: You can learn teamwork and strategy from games.
bear: Playing too much might distract from studying.
